sourceContext.note: New custom block. Code copied faithfully from the source site's served blocks/guide-nav/{guide-nav.js,guide-nav.css}. Not a Block Collection block.

contentPattern.structure: single cell with a list of anchor links (lead 'Back' link + per-section jump links)

behavior: Renders links as a sticky vertical nav rail, marks the first link as a lead link, intercepts in-page hash jumps for JS-controlled smooth scrolling with layout-shift correction, and adds the 'guide-layout' class to its containing section to enable the two-column care-guide layout.

suitableFor: multi-section reference documents needing in-page jump navigation
notSuitableFor: short pages without multiple anchored sections
